name: bus
description: A low-floor city bus: a body lofted from its side silhouette with real wheel arches and rounded corners, a see-through window band over seats, poles and the driver's place, a roof with cooling unit and hatches, a destination display and rabbit-ear mirrors, two glazed passenger doors on the right-hand side hinged at their front edge, and steel wheels (twin at the rear) with the pivot at the hub.
